## Purpose

Explain the developer problem.

## Changes

What changed? Include public API and compatibility implications.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run example` when relevant
- [ ] Tests and documentation cover failure paths
- [ ] No secrets, confidential source, or real customer data

## Security

How does this affect identity, policy, approval, execution, auditing, verification, or retries?
